title: Recurring characters
content: Is it common to have recurring people you don't know in your waking life show up there? I'm feeling quite literally haunted by a recurring man/boy...his age fluctuates...who is no one I've ever known. He is always there. I posted earlier that he's always in one particular room, so naturally for the last few nights he's been everywhere else. I think he's pissed. Any theories on who the dream people are?
